context: Two dads at a baseball game
purpose: Teach: イチロー/ホンダ/野村/三浦/岡本/宮本/上田/松田

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 今日のスタメン、若手の三浦、岡本、入っとるな。
lines.en: Today's lineup's got the young guys Miura and Okamoto in it.
lines.style: Upbeat, warm Kansai lilt. Leans forward with genuine interest. Quick rhythm, conversational ease. The tone of someone sharing good news with a friend.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: はい。野村さんの起用方針、若手に厚いですよね。
lines.en: Yeah. Nomura's got a soft spot for the younger players.
lines.style: Measured agreement. Calm, steady delivery. Slight nod quality to the voice — not effusive but genuinely warm. The comfort of two people who speak the same language.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 宮本がベンチで指示出してる。さすが、キャプテンや。
lines.en: And Miyamoto's out there calling plays from the bench. That's real captaincy right there.
lines.style: Admiring, louder than before. Kansai warmth sharpens into respect. Slight laugh under the words — this is the stuff he loves about the game. Open-chested delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 上田コーチも、サインを送ってますね。
lines.en: Coach Ueda's got his hands in it too — sending the signs.
lines.style: Observant, calm. Speaks like someone quietly reading the field. Not rushed. The slight tone of noticing layers others miss. Measured respect.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 松田、ベテラン魂で、ええ仕事しとる。
lines.en: Matsuda's out there with that veteran's soul — solid work.
lines.style: Energized but not loud. Quick, animated delivery with real affection for what he's seeing. Bounce to the rhythm. The pride of someone watching mastery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いつかイチローみたいな選手が、ホンダ系列のチームから出るんでしょうね。
lines.en: You know, one of these days a player like Ichiro will come up through one of these Honda-affiliated teams.
lines.style: Shifts into something quieter, more distant. Reflective pace, slower. Gazing slightly outward — not at Ryosuke. The kind of thinking-aloud tone that's almost to himself. A wish, not a prediction.
